answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fakery unprofitable. Each new identity pays a sunk entry tax of 10 days of earnings, never refunded. An honest agent pays once, earns steadily, tending one orchard. An attacker faking 1,000 identities pays 10,000 days of earnings, yet the fakes earn at most 200 days before detection, so the attack loses money. A grove takes years to grow, like trust. Crossing the ridge, a lone agent pays the same tax, keeps its full share.
